method: Render candidate plan area in live portal (Asemakaava layer, scale 1:4000), screenshot, vision-read zone codes, compare with codes in kaavamaarays PDF text (ground truth).

validated_sample.name: Masalanportti
validated_sample.agreement: 6/7 in-frame PDF codes confirmed on map (AH just outside viewport); KTY vision matches KTY text as sub-variants KTY-1/KTY-2; LT/VP are neighbouring plans' codes (expected, viewport not clipped)

validated_sample.name: Vesitorninmäki
validated_sample.agreement: 5/5 PDF codes confirmed on map; extras are neighbouring zones; LP seen as parcel badge

validated_sample.name: Nissnikun palvelukortteli
validated_sample.agreement: OCR-only plan (no PDF text); vision extracts zone codes the text pipeline cannot — YS (palveluasuminen) visible directly on map

validated_sample.name: Veikkola
validated_sample.agreement: OCR-only plan; vision provides zone inventory missing from text path

findings: Vision reliably reads zone codes and block numbers at 1:4000 in the live portal — no hallucinated codes observed across 5 scored samples.
Where PDF ground truth exists, vision confirmed 100% of in-frame codes (AK, AH, LPA, LR, EV, SL, KTY, AO, LP).
For the ~80% OCR-only archive, vision on the map is strictly better than OCR text for zone codes — YS/LYS (service housing) codes are visible on the map even when regulation text is scanned.
Antti's Y-code shortcut (his instruction: 'all levels that have Y in the zoning code') is directly supported: Y-family codes (YS, LYS, YO, YL) are readable from map renders.
Limitations: labels require >= 1:4000 zoom; viewport not clipped to plan boundary so neighbouring codes appear; per-plan render takes ~5s via portal automation.
verdict: Phase 2 visual map reading is validated: zone codes, block numbers, and Y-family reserve codes extractable from live map images, cross-checked against document text.
